Bright and luminous. NOT foggy, NOT grey, NOT beige, NOT sepia, NOT photographic. Gallery quality, modern. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no frame, no border, no people in focus. Landscape format, 1536x1024 (the largest landscape size).
